# Tooltip

Provide information on hover with a content cell.
See [Tooltip guidelines<i class="mat-icon">launch</i>](https://design-system.airbus.corp/components/tooltip/design/)

The `ds-tooltip` and `ds-tooltip-arrow` classes only provide basic styling, positioning must be handled by a library such as [Popper.js](https://popper.js.org/).
